question: An equivalence relation $R$ in $A$ divides it into equivalence classes $A_1$, $A_2$, $A_3$. What is the value of $A_1 \cup A_2 \cup A_3$ & $A_1 \cap A_2 \cap A_3$.

options.A: $A_1 \cup A_2 \cup A_3 = A$ and $A_1 \cap A_2 \cap A_3 = \emptyset$
options.B: $A_1 \cup A_2 \cup A_3 = \emptyset$ and $A_1 \cap A_2 \cap A_3 = A$
options.C: $A_1 \cup A_2 \cup A_3 = A$ and $A_1 \cap A_2 \cap A_3 = A$
